To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a small clinical study can be organized to collect data efficiently and economically; (2) the organization of data can be simplified by using a data management system based on a relational database; and (3) a relational database can be used to organize and manage the data collected in a small clinical trial.
